description: Header file defining classes and templates for Netlink socket communication, including message framing, parameter handling, and connector types within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class for Netlink message handling, including serialization, deserialization, and message framing.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Template class for handling message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message ingestion.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class for managing Netlink socket communication, including sending, receiving, and message exchange.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink message.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs a send and receive exchange of Netlink messages.
